issues.code_location: BlobGas.java - entire class, no blob fee method
issues.description: BlobGas.java is only a UInt64 quantity wrapper (of/wrap/fromHexString). It contains no implementation of fake_exponential, get_base_fee_per_blob_gas, get_total_blob_gas, calc_blob_fee or calculate_data_fee. None of the Parameters MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS=1, BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION=3338477, GAS_PER_BLOB=2**17 are referenced.
issues.potential_impact: Without correct blob base-fee calculation nodes will charge/validate wrong blob fee, deduct wrong burned amount, and diverge on block validity leading to consensus split and fee-market manipulation.
issues.spec_reference: def get_base_fee_per_blob_gas(header: Header) -> int: return fake_exponential( MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS, header.excess_blob_gas, BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION )
issues.suggestion: Implement fake_exponential(factor, numerator, denominator) via Taylor expansion exactly as specified and get_base_fee_per_blob_gas, get_total_blob_gas=GAS_PER_BLOB*len(blob_versioned_hashes), calc_blob_fee outside datatype or in fee-market module.

verification.matched_excerpt: def get_base_fee_per_blob_gas(header: Header) -> int: return fake_exponential( MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS, header.excess_blob_gas, BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION )

issues.code_location: BlobGas.java - entire class, no excess_blob_gas logic
issues.description: No calc_excess_blob_gas, no header fields blob_gas_used/excess_blob_gas, no validation that block.header.excess_blob_gas == calc_excess_blob_gas(parent). TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK=393216 not defined or used.
issues.potential_impact: Incorrect excess tracking breaks the self-correcting EIP-1559-style market; blocks with wrong excess would be accepted/rejected incorrectly causing permanent chain split.
issues.spec_reference: def calc_excess_blob_gas(parent: Header) -> int: if parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used < TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK: return 0 else: return parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used - TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK
issues.suggestion: Add 64-bit header fields blob_gas_used/excess_blob_gas, implement calc_excess_blob_gas exactly including parent-as-0 for first post-fork block and enforce equality check in block validation.

verification.matched_excerpt: def calc_excess_blob_gas(parent: Header) -> int: if parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used < TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK: return 0 else: return parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used - TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK

issues.description: Code defines MAX_BLOB_GAS as UInt64.MAX_VALUE (2**64-1) instead of spec MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK=786432 (6 blobs * 131072). No enforcement of assert blob_gas_used <= MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK or assert block.header.blob_gas_used == blob_gas_used, and no per-tx blob_gas_available check.
issues.potential_impact: Allowing >6 blobs per block (~0.75 MB limit) permits oversized blocks, DoS/bandwidth exhaustion, and consensus divergence from spec-compliant clients that enforce 786432 limit.
issues.suggestion: Define MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK as 786432, TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK as 393216, GAS_PER_BLOB as 2**17 and enforce cumulative blob_gas_used limit and header match in block validation.

issues.code_location: BlobGas.java - entire class, no KZG/versioned-hash logic
issues.description: No kzg_to_versioned_hash, no KZGCommitment/KZGProof KeyValidate checks, no verify_kzg_proof/verify_blob_kzg_proof_batch, and no network gossip validation (equal lengths, commitments hash to versioned hashes, commitments match blobs/proofs).
issues.potential_impact: Without binding commitments to versioned hashes and batch verification, invalid or unavailable blob data could be accepted, breaking data-availability guarantees for rollups and causing consensus split with verifying clients.
issues.spec_reference: def kzg_to_versioned_hash(commitment: KZGCommitment) -> VersionedHash: return VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG + sha256(commitment)[1:]
issues.suggestion: Implement kzg_to_versioned_hash with VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG=0x01, enforce commitment KeyValidate (allow identity), and enforce PooledTransactions sidecar checks using verify_blob_kzg_proof_batch.

issues.code_location: BlobGas.java - entire class, no precompile or opcode
issues.description: No POINT_EVALUATION_PRECOMPILE_ADDRESS (0x0A) with 50000 gas, no 192-byte input parsing, no commitment-vs-versioned_hash check, no verify_kzg_proof(z,y), no return of FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB/BLS_MODULUS, no rejection of non-canonical field elements >= BLS_MODULUS, and no BLOBHASH opcode 0x49 with gas 3 and out-of-range->zero semantics.
issues.potential_impact: Missing/incorrect precompile or BLOBHASH breaks EVM contracts (rollup fraud/equivalence proofs) and causes consensus divergence; skipping canonicality check enables malleability/forgery.
issues.suggestion: Add precompile at 0x0A costing 50000, assert len==192, verify kzg_to_versioned_hash==versioned_hash, verify_kzg_proof, reject z,y >= BLS_MODULUS, return padded FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB and BLS_MODULUS; add BLOBHASH opcode 0x49 costing 3 returning tx.blob_versioned_hashes[index] or zero.

summary: BlobGas.java is only a generic UInt64 quantity wrapper and implements none of EIP-4844 consensus logic. All core requirements - blob base-fee, excess update, block limit, tx validation, KZG/versioned-hash, precompile/opcode - are absent, with MAX constant deviating to 2**64-1, guaranteeing consensus failure if used as the fork implementation.
